ja327:1.1: Vāti cāyaṃ tato gandho yattha me vasatī piyā, dūre ito hi Kākāti yattha me nirato mano ti.
ja327:2.1: Kathaṃ samuddaṃ patari, kathaṃ patari Kebukaṃ, kathaṃ satta samuddāni kathaṃ simbalim āruhīti.
ja327:3.1: Tayā samuddam atariṃ, tayā atari Kebukaṃ, tayā satta samuddāni, tayā simbalim āruhin ti.
ja327:4.1: Dhi-r-atthu maṃ mahākāyaṃ, dhi-r-atthu maṃ acetanaṃ, yattha jāyāy' ahaṃ jāraṃ āvahāmi vahāmi vā ti.
